svg.title: GKOS layer responsibilities and governing records
svg.desc: Original Sources produce a Source Record, Structure and Identity a Structured Knowledge Object, and Relationships and Lineage assertion and lineage records. Validation and Control produces diagnostics and control receipts, Review and Workflow a Decision Record, Context Presentation a Context Manifest, and Authorized Use an Authorized Use Record. These cumulative responsibilities are grouped into knowledge substrate, decision and control, and governance envelope; they are not a mandatory synchronous pipeline.
